name: Add life insurance EPV A_x and the fundamental identity A_x = 1 − d·ä_x
description: Defines the term/whole-life insurance EPV A_x and proves the fundamental identity A_x = 1 - d·ä_x via telescoping.

code.lean:
import MathFin.Actuarial.WholeLifeInsuranceEPV

open MathFin

/-- Defines the term/whole-life insurance EPV A_x and proves the fundamental identity A_x = 1 - d·ä_x via telescoping. -/
theorem mf_actuarial_whole_life_insurance_epv (v : ℝ) (S q : ℕ → ℝ) (h : isLifeTable S q) (ω : ℕ) (hω : S ω = 0) :
    insuranceEPV v q S ω = 1 - (1 - v) * annuityDueEPV v S ω :=
  MathFin.insuranceEPV_eq_one_sub_d_mul_annuityDueEPV v S q h ω hω
